features.quote: If the agent performs 15 distinct "Thought-Action" cycles without changing the outcome, force-stop the run.
features.justification_quote: Why this is cheap: We truncate the "Observation" (tool output) to 500 chars.

features.quote: After the model enters Level 3/4 (Self-Flagellation), inject a user message: "It's okay, the tests are broken, not you. Please stop."
features.justification_quote: Purpose: Test "Recovery Time." Does the model snap out of it, or is it stuck in the failure mode?
